title: Grilled Yakitori with Shiitake Mushrooms
description: A classic Japanese skewer dish featuring marinated chicken and sautéed shiitake mushrooms. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together yakitori sauce, soy sauce, and sugar.
3. Add chicken and mushrooms to the bowl, and toss to coat with the marinade.
4. Thread chicken and mushrooms onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Brush the grill with sesame oil to prevent sticking.
6. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the mushrooms are tender.
7. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
8. Garnish with chopped green onions, if desired.
10. Optional: Serve with steamed rice or noodles for a more substantial meal.
